answer: Random jury of 9 drawn from the validator garden each epoch without replacement. A farm controlling k% of identities seats a full jury only k^9 of the time — 10% ownership yields 10⁻⁹. The reef of honest nodes stays uncrackable while sybils sink. Detection flags any violet cluster of co-registered keys sharing stake origin. Attacker burns capital on thousands of nodes for a one-in-a-billion swing; expected return goes negative long before that. Sampling without replacement makes capture exponentially costly, so honest majority holds.
